name: recipes-pwa
description: Recipes PWA: React + Vite client and an Express proxy for TheMealDB

scripts.setup: npm install && npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,client -c blue,magenta "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix client run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix server run build && npm --prefix client run build
scripts.preview: concurrently -k -n server,client -c blue,magenta "npm --prefix server run start" "npm --prefix client run preview"
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix server run typecheck && npm --prefix client run typecheck
